<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 4"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Battering Wings](/Feats.aspx?ID=5528) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Archetype" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=535" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 82

**Archetype** [Winged Warrior](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=227)

**Prerequisites**
[Winged Warrior Dedication](/Feats.aspx?ID=5527)

</column>

---

Though not powerful enough for flight, your wings can deliver a thrashing to anyone who gets close. You gain a wing unarmed attack that deals 1d4 bludgeoning damage. Your wing attack is in the [brawling](/WeaponGroups.aspx?ID=4) group and has the [agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=526), [finesse](/Traits.aspx?ID=602), and [unarmed](/Traits.aspx?ID=719) traits.
